title: Goodbye Manual Data Entry
facebook_comment_text: Beyond just hours, manual data entry's real sting is in the *cumulative impact* of human error and the missed opportunity cost of skilled teams stuck on repetitive tasks. 💡 The engineering challenge isn't just OCR, but truly *understanding* nuanced, variable unstructured text at scale. What's the most surprising hidden cost manual data entry has exacted in *your* organization?
